description: This file defines a PHP class 'Sale' within the Opencart admin dashboard extension, responsible for rendering the sales dashboard, managing settings, and reporting sales data.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Controller class for the sale dashboard extension in Opencart admin, handling display, settings, and sales data retrieval.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the sale dashboard configuration form with breadcrumb navigation and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the sale dashboard, returning JSON response indicating success or errors.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates and returns sales data visualization, including total sales, percentage change from previous day, and links.
